_comment: Project fidelity config for SPX recipient detail (personal) page 954:9716. Inherits tolerances/iconDeviations from account-states sibling; extends iconDeviations for the new figma icons used in this screen (trash bin, copy, money/wallet, money/card, users/user-circle, badge user-icon).

deviations.reason: Right-side balance group uses flex space-between against figma master width 326. PJS-rendered amount glyph 10,000.00 USD is ~10px narrower than figma's reported width (75 vs 86), so the right group sits ~10-13px further right while its RIGHT edge stays aligned with the cell padding. Numeric token (color/weight/size) all match — this is a font-glyph-width rendering artifact, not a layout defect. Applies to both sell (10,000.00 USD) and buy (10,000.00 HKD) cells.

Same flex space-between text-width artifact as 可用余额: above. The balance-row right edge is aligned correctly; the value's left edge sits ~10px further right because PJS glyph widths are tighter than figma's HarmonyOS reference.
Same as 10,000.00 USD — buy-cell right-balance value, identical text-width artifact.

Exchange info rate-value position: figma reports right-edge based on HarmonyOS glyph width (figma w=42). PJS renders ~3-5px narrower so the value left edge sits a few px right of figma. Right edge still anchored to the row's right boundary via space-between.

Exchange-info cell row baseline ascent: figma TEXT y reports HarmonyOS Sans TC ink-box top inside its row; web Range.getBoundingClientRect on PJS reports the glyph ink-box top which sits ~11px lower due to PJS-Bold ascent line metrics vs HarmonyOS. Cell position correct (master y=324), row marginTop 18 = figma 342 line-frame top; residual delta = font-metric ascent difference.
Same row as 汇率 above — same font-metric ascent delta.
Second row of exchange-info cell, +32 below first row (figma 374). Same font-metric ascent delta as 汇率/100 HKD row.
Same row as 卖出 above — same font-metric ascent delta.
Third row of exchange-info cell (figma 407). Same font-metric ascent delta. fontSize differs (14 not 12) so visual offset is slightly larger.
Same row as 实际到账金额. fontSize 14 w700 — same PJS-Bold ascent delta.
Receive-amount 未选转入 right-aligned amount value: same PJS-glyph-width-narrower-than-HarmonyOS artifact as 10,000.00 USD on the buysell screen. Right edge anchored, left edge ~8px right of figma.

deviations.reason: Delete-dialog body text uses textAlign:center inside a 252-wide layer. Figma's absoluteBoundingBox reports the layer left edge (x=24); the impl is measured via Range.getBoundingClientRect which returns the ink box (centered within the 252 layer, so the ink left sits at ~54). Identical ink/layer mismatch as cards/dialog screens — center-aligned text where layer is wider than glyph run. The right edge / vertical centering / typography all match figma exactly.
